subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close after a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require broader switch feedback, live-target proof, and optional identity/switcher/prefix UX?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested workspace context, one open PR implements the focused breadcrumb but conflicts with main, and another open PR removes the breadcrumb surface entirely, so automation cannot choose the final Dashboard header product contract.

options.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep this issue open until a rebased focused breadcrumb lands, then close it while tracking optional switcher/prefix/live-proof ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require the implementation to also cover switch confirmation and stronger live-target proof before this issue can close.

options.title: Replace Header Surface
options.body: Choose the no-breadcrumb/topbar direction and redesign multi-agent/workspace certainty in another persistent UI surface before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a rebased focused breadcrumb lands, then close it while tracking optional switcher/prefix/live-proof ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the current active-agent header breadcrumb and is the strongest history match for the Dashboard header UX surface.
